response:
Snorlax is the perfect counter to Sabrina's Psychic-types, combining massive Special Defense to absorb her attacks with high physical Attack to exploit her team's weak physical bulk [1].

### Top picks

#### Snorlax (core)
* **Where:** Route 12 or Route 16 by using the Poké Flute (Lv30) [2][3].
* **When:** Available immediately, before entering Saffron Gym [2].
* **Why it helps now:** It has an enormous HP stat (160) and excellent Special Defense (110) to sponge Sabrina's Special-based Psychic attacks [1]. Since Ghost is a physical type in Gen III, Snorlax is one of the best users of TM30 Shadow Ball (bought at the Celadon Game Corner), dealing heavy physical damage to Sabrina's physically frail Psychic-types [1][4][5].
* **Key moves:** Body Slam, Shadow Ball (TM30 from Celadon Game Corner) [6][4][5].
* **Long run:** Outstanding [1]. It remains one of the strongest overall Pokémon through the Elite Four and Champion due to its sheer bulk, Thick Fat/Immunity ability, and wide TM learnset [1].
* **Backup:** Scyther (core; Celadon Prize Corner for 5,500 coins or Safari Zone, Lv23-28) [7]. It has high physical Attack (110) and Speed (105) to strike hard with physical Bug-type moves against Sabrina's fragile Psychic-types [8]. While it cannot evolve into Scizor until the postgame National Dex, it still functions well as a fast physical attacker [9][8].

---

### Key Battles

#### Gym 6: Sabrina
Sabrina uses Kadabra (Lv38), Mr. Mime (Lv37), Venomoth (Lv38), and Alakazam (Lv43) [10][11][12][13]. Kadabra, Mr. Mime, and Alakazam all use Calm Mind to raise their Special Attack and Special Defense [10][11][13]. Target their weak physical Defense with strong physical attackers [10]. Be cautious of Mr. Mime, which can set up physical defense with Barrier and use Baton Pass to give its stat boosts to Alakazam [11].

---

### Next steps

1. **Navigate Silph Co.:** Retrieve the Card Key on 5F to unlock the electronic doors [14].
2. **Defeat the Rival:** Use the warp panel on 3F to reach the northwest room on 7F, where you will battle your Rival [15][16][17].
3. **Clear out Team Rocket:** Continue to 11F and defeat Giovanni [18]. This clears the Team Rocket Grunts blocking Saffron Gym, allowing you to challenge Sabrina [19].

---

### Assumptions
* You have enough money or Game Corner coins to obtain TM30 Shadow Ball from Celadon City, which is highly recommended for Snorlax [5].

### To sharpen this
* Do you have access to physical TM moves like Return to exploit the low physical Defense of Sabrina's Psychic-types?

plan.headline: Snorlax is the perfect counter to Sabrina's Psychic-types, combining massive Special Defense to absorb her attacks with high physical Attack to exploit her team's weak physical bulk.

recommendations.when: Available immediately, before entering Saffron Gym.
recommendations.why: It has an enormous HP stat (160) and excellent Special Defense (110) to sponge Sabrina's Special-based Psychic attacks. Since Ghost is a physical type in Gen III, Snorlax is one of the best users of TM30 Shadow Ball (bought at Celadon Game Corner), dealing heavy physical damage to Sabrina's physically frail Psychic-types.
recommendations.long_term: Outstanding. It remains one of the strongest overall Pokémon through the Elite Four and Champion due to its sheer bulk, Thick Fat/Immunity ability, and wide TM learnset.
key_moves: Shadow Ball (TM30 from Celadon Game Corner)

alternatives.where: Celadon City Prize Corner (5500 coins) or Safari Zone, Lv23-28
alternatives.why: High physical Attack (110) and Speed (105) allow it to strike hard with physical Bug-type moves against Sabrina's fragile Psychic-types.
alternatives.long_term: Decent, though it cannot evolve into Scizor until the postgame National Dex. It still functions well as a fast physical attacker.

steps.title: Navigate Silph Co.
steps.detail: Retrieve the Card Key on 5F to unlock the electronic doors.

steps.title: Defeat the Rival
steps.detail: Use the warp panel on 3F to reach the northwest room on 7F, where you will battle your Rival.

steps.title: Clear out Team Rocket
steps.detail: Continue to 11F and defeat Giovanni. This clears the Team Rocket Grunts blocking Saffron Gym, allowing you to challenge Sabrina.

battle_notes.note: Sabrina's team consists of Kadabra (Lv38), Mr. Mime (Lv37), Venomoth (Lv38), and Alakazam (Lv43). Kadabra, Mr. Mime, and Alakazam all use Calm Mind to raise their Special Attack and Special Defense. Target their weak physical Defense with strong physical attackers. Be cautious of Mr. Mime, which can set up physical defense with Barrier and use Baton Pass to give its stat boosts to Alakazam.

assumptions: You have enough money or coins to obtain TM30 Shadow Ball from the Celadon Game Corner, which is highly recommended for Snorlax.
follow_up_questions: Do you have access to physical TM moves like Return to exploit the low physical Defense of Sabrina's Psychic-types?
